description: This deck uses space to easily win the drain race, I've yet to meet a Light deck in the E1 enviroment that uses more than 2 starships.

notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (6): Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and I Will Find Them Quickly, Master; these count toward the 60. No Objective.

The title and strategy call this a Type II deck 'for the E1 environment only' (Episode I-only sets); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set Dark printings are used for Coruscant, Tatooine, Alter, Sense and Control; Dark pages for Naboo, Malastare, Podrace Arena and Boonta Eve Podrace.
Tusken Raider (Premiere) is listed as posted although it is not an Episode I card.

Posted 'Darth Maul, YA' dested Darth Maul, Young Apprentice; 'Keeder the Black' dested Keder The Black; 'Trade Federation Battle Ship' dested Trade Federation Battleship; 'Mauls Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'Malastar' dested Malastare; 'Nemoidian Advisor' dested Neimoidian Advisor; 'Drop' dested Drop!; 'Allegations of Coruption' dested the Coruscant Effect Allegations Of Corruption (the Reflections III Defensive Shield came out after this post).
The section header 'Other (1)' was removed; If The Trace Was Correct sits under it.
